extract bytes input from PDF document

```rust title="Rust"
use xberg::extract;
use xberg::ExtractInput;

#[tokio::main]
async fn main() {
    let mut input_json: serde_json::Value = serde_json::from_str(r#"{"bytes":"pdf/fake_memo.pdf","filename":"fake_memo.pdf","kind":"bytes","mime_type":"application/pdf"}"#).unwrap();
    let input_file_0 = std::fs::read(r#"pdf/fake_memo.pdf"#).expect("file read failed");
    *input_json.pointer_mut(r#"/bytes"#).expect("docs file field missing") = serde_json::json!(input_file_0);
    let input = serde_json::from_value::<ExtractInput>(input_json).unwrap();
    let config = Default::default();
    let result = extract(input, &config).await.expect("call failed");
    println!("{:?}", result.results[0].mime_type);
    println!("{:?}", result.results[0].content);
}
```
